mike_procurement: Heads-up — vendor asking for a customs retainer to release 20 H100s early. quoted $6k, says broker will priority-clear if paid. thoughts?
ashley_ops: ugh, surprise fees. do we have a standard policy for paying broker retainers?
julia_logistics: we usually avoid, but if clearing saves 5–7 days and avoids depot queue we should weigh cost vs SLA. need estimate of lost revenue/impact.
dan_vendor: Confirming — forwarder requires retainer to cover potential duties & brokerage hold. we can split retainer if Redwood prepays now, then deduct from final invoice. AWB provided: CX1234567890.
mike_procurement: can you send exact scope? retainer amount breakdown (brokerage vs duties vs handling)?
dan_vendor: broker fee $3.5k, customs deposit $2k (refundable), courier priority $500. docs attached in vendor portal.
ashley_ops: if customs deposit refundable, net risk ~$3.5k. what's the ETA improvement?
dan_vendor: typical release time without retainer: 10–14 business days. with retainer + priority lane: 48–72 hours to handoff.
julia_logistics: 48–72h would knock out a full week of provisioning. cluster schedule shows we can consume capacity immediately in EMEA pool.
mike_procurement: who owns RMA/returns if any DOA on early-release units? we need clarity on warranty path & reverse logistics.
dan_vendor: same RMA terms apply. any DOA processed via standard RMA portal. priority release doesn't change warranty.
ashley_ops: need to confirm serial manifest before payment. last time we had a missing-serial mismatch and depot rejected 2 units.
dan_vendor: understood. uploading manifest now: 
```
SKU,HUNDRED_SERIES_SERIAL,AWB
H100,HSN123456789, CX1234567890
H100,HSN123456790, CX1234567890
... (20 rows)
```
mike_procurement: ok we'll do a PO addendum: retainer prepaid $3.5k broker fee non-refundable, customs deposit $2k held in escrow, offset from invoice. vendor to confirm serials and final AWB.
julia_logistics: add clause: if any serials flagged DOA at depot, vendor covers return shipment and replacement within 7 days. otherwise we accept standard SLA.
dan_vendor: agreed to addendum. can you sign and wire?
mike_procurement: finance — can you approve wire for $5.5k split 50/50 across procurement budget and ops retainer? @ashley_ops this sits with ops for approval on the clause.
ashley_ops: approve on clause. ops will take $2.75k. please include GL code: OPS-PROV-EMEA.
ashley_ops: also flag to eng-sre that these units will arrive into the EMEA staging cluster — schedule a hot-join window for 3/25 10:00 UTC.
mike_procurement: sending signed addendum now.
 rma_bot: [automated] RMA ticket #RMA-83921 created for received DOA claims against AWB CX1234567890. Please attach photos + depot acceptance form within 72h of handoff.
julia_logistics: noted. ops to prep depot checklist and manifest reconciliation.
ashley_ops: pinging customs broker contact for expedited clearance confirmation. will update when wire cleared. :thumbsup:
mike_procurement: thanks team — if broker retainer works we buy back ~5 production days; seems worth it.
ashley_ops: agree — small premium to avoid multi-week queue and customer SLA impact.
adan_vendor: thanks — will escalate priority on pickup once wire posts.
mike_procurement: last ask — capture insurance endorsement for transit and customs deposit on PO. dan_vendor, confirm insured value equals invoice line.
dan_vendor: confirmed insured value matches invoice. will attach endorsement after pickup.
